name: Context Minimal Fanout Skills
description: Distributable harness-agnostic skills for context-minimal decomposition, design, and fanout workflows.

skills.name: Decompose Then Implement
skills.description: Gather focused context, decompose the task into persisted subtasks, then implement each subtask sequentially.

skills.name: Decompose, Design, Then Implement
skills.description: Gather context, decompose into subtasks, write a short solution design for each subtask, then implement the designs sequentially.

skills.name: Decompose, Design, Fanout
skills.description: Gather context, decompose into subtasks, write per-subtask design docs, then launch one subagent per design doc.

skills.name: Decompose Fanout
skills.description: Decompose one large task into non-overlapping subtasks, launch one subagent per subtask, then merge and report.
